d: A humanoid goat-like creature with a slender, athletic build and tan-brown skin. The head features a canine-like snout, narrow golden-brown eyes, and long, pointed ears partially hidden by thick, voluminous platinum white hair that is styled in a swept-back, layered look. Two long, dark brown curved horns emerge from the top of the head, accented by golden rings. The outfit consists of a deep crimson draped cloak and matching shoulder wrap fastened by a gold brooch with a red gem, worn over a minimal red waist-wrap and dark charcoal-grey leggings with red and gold boots. BODY COLOR: Tan-brown LEGS: Digitigrade with cloven hooves.
